children: New Delhi, Oct. 4 -- Senior citizens can find fixed deposit rates as high as 8.50% in October 2026. These annual interest rates were taken from Paisa Bazaar, which updated them on 1 October 2026. These rates apply to deposits below Rs.3 crore.

Small finance banks offer the highest maximum rates among the listed banks. Equitas, ESAF and Suryoday Small Finance Banks each show a maximum of 8.50%. However, this maximum does not apply to every deposit period.

Suryoday offers 8.50% for five years, compared with 7.40% for one- and three-year terms. Equitas offers 7.60% for 1 and 3 years, and 7.50% for 5 years. ESAF offers 6.50% for one and three years, falling to 6.25% for five years.
For one-year deposits, Unity Small Finance Bank leads the listed banks with 8%. Ujjivan follows with 7.75%. Capital and Equitas each offer 7.60%, while Jana offers 7.50%.
Jana Small Finance Bank offers 8.30% for three years and 7.77% for five years. AU offers 7.90% for three years while Utkarsh offers 8%. Ujjivan offers 7.75% for three years and 7.70% for five years.
Among private banks, SBM Bank has the highest maximum rate, at 8.15%. Its one-year and three-year rates are both 7.60%. Its five-year rate is 7.50%.

DCB Bank offers a maximum rate of 8% for five-year deposits. Its one-year rate is 7.15% while three-year deposits earn 7.25%. Bandhan Bank's maximum is 7.95%. It offers 7.50% for one year and 7.75% for three years.
IndusInd and YES Bank both offer 7.75% for three-year deposits. Their five-year rates are 7.15% and 7.50%, respectively.
HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank show identical rates across the listed periods. Both offer 6.75%, 6.95% and 6.90% for one, three and five years, respectively.
Among public sector banks, Bank of India has the highest maximum rate, at 7.45%. This rate applies to three-year deposits. Its one-year rate is 7%, while five-year deposits earn 6.75%.
State Bank of India leads listed public banks for five-year deposits, offering 7.05%. Bank of Baroda offers 6.90% for five years. Canara Bank offers 6.75% across all three listed periods.

Indian Overseas Bank matches Bank of India's one-year rate of 7%. Punjab National Bank offers 6.80% for three years and 6.60% for five years. Punjab & Sind Bank's maximum reaches 7.35%, while its five-year rate is 6.45%.

Longer deposits do not always earn higher rates. A bank's maximum rate can differ considerably from its standard deposit periods. Comparisons, therefore, depend on both the bank and the chosen duration.

title: FD rates for senior citizens in October 2026: Interest reaches 8.50% in these banks
